verified: Multiple outlets, citing an FBI warning, report that the bureau named ARTEX — described as an open-source, AI-powered penetration-testing framework whose agents automate network attacks — as a tool used in intrusions, including against a U.S. IT company and South Korea's financial sector.
unconfirmed: The claim that some intrusions reached privileged access in under three hours rests on the FBI's account as relayed by secondary outlets; the supplied material does not name the victims, give a count of affected organizations, link the tool to the reported ConnectWise-related supply-chain incident, or include the FBI advisory itself or any independent technical analysis.

verified: 据 TechCrunch、BleepingComputer 和 CybersecurityNews 等多家媒体报道，美国联邦调查局（FBI）发出警告，称攻击者正在使用一个名为 ARTEX 的开源 AI 渗透测试框架来自动化网络攻击；这些报道称，FBI 将针对一家美国 IT 公司和韩国金融业的入侵与这一工具联系起来，并指出部分入侵在不到三小时内就获得了特权访问权限（BleepingComputer 还提到了一起 ConnectWise 供应链事件）。
unconfirmed: FBI 原始公告的全文及技术细节（攻击手法、ARTEX 的具体版本或组件、入侵指标）未在所引报道中给出；“三小时内取得特权访问”这一数字的统计范围与样本也不清楚；受害组织均未具名，ConnectWise 供应链事件的关联仅见于单一报道，尚无独立确认。

titles.en: FBI ties Artex AI open-source hacking tool to sub-three-hour breaches
titles.zh: FBI：开源AI黑客工具Artex AI不到三小时攻破网络
